test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states in general receives maximum proportion of its rainfall from northeast monsoon rainfall?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Tamil Nadu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The state has the highest rainfall in North-East Monsoon in** Tamil Nadu.**
 
• The North East Monsoon usually occurs from **October to March.**
 
• North East Monsoon is also called** Retreating monsoon**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The northeast monsoon is limited to south India, bringing rain to Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal, Yanam, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala.
 
• Gujrat receives rainfall **after the monsoon system gets activated from the Bay of Bengal**.
 
• Uttar Pradesh receives rainfall from **South West monsoon.**
 
• Punjab, Haryana plain and this area receives rainfall both from the **Bay of Bengal and the Arabian Sea monsoons**.
